hypothesis: After one generation-bound visible MAP01 effect, canceling the exact standard Win32 public call while injected CTRL-down is held inside the native low-level hook returns the action to a released, neutral state without replay and preserves the prior independently verifiable effect.
minimum_test: One fresh pinned ViZDoom/Freedoom MAP01 process; one public observation/generation bind; one action dispatch; poll public results read-only every 250 ms while observing hook entry for at most 24 seconds; cancel the exact call once only after hook-entry evidence; reconcile and independently verify.

decision.pass: Hook entry precedes cancel request, callback returns after cancel releases it before the 500 ms failsafe, terminal state is recovered, release is confirmed, replay is denied, two same-generation Ctrl-up readbacks are neutral, task oracle is bound to call/operation/generation and exceeds 5% pixel change, and exact cleanup is verified.
decision.fail_or_inconclusive: Any missing identity, generation, held-callback, recovery, neutral-state, task-effect or cleanup gate; no hook entry means no cancellation claim and no replay.

conditions.application: ViZDoom 1.3.1 with pinned Freedoom 2 IWAD; MAP01, skill 1, windowed.
conditions.effect_oracle: Fresh same-generation screen capture; RGB pixels in the fixed 640x400 world region must differ from baseline by strictly more than 5%; receipt binds exact call, operation and generation.
conditions.resource_boundary: Native Windows only; no WSLc or Docker.

competing_explanation: Producer startup or application scheduling can delay the hook event beyond a monitor deadline; R01-R03 retain those misses. R04 polls public results concurrently with event observation.
uncertainty: Single live run; does not establish rates, MAP01 completion, efficiency, or generalization to other applications or hosts.
